description: A Cachet Vantage 900 — matte graphite, seamless, taller than you and about as wide as a coffin laid flat. The kind of cabinet that costs more than the room it stands in. Sample bolts of fabric sit on its shelves under a hairline of warm light, each one on a little motorised tray, and the whole facade is machined so precisely that no join is visible anywhere on it. Cachet's marketing calls it a discretion suite. Cachet's marketing does not say what for.
name: Cachet Vantage 900 cabinet
